# S & B Rolloff Inc

> S & B Rolloff Inc is a Waste management service serving Locust Grove, Georgia. S & B Rolloff and Transfer Station provide commercial roll-off dumpster service as well as a Transfer Station conveniently located only 5 minutes from I-75 in Locust Grove, GA. The Transfer Station is accessible in all weather and the average turnaround time for dumping is only 1
